per_candidate.id: s2:Weak Magnetic Fields in the Outer Solar Nebula Recorded in CR Chondrites

rationale: The papers 2101.04129 and 1812.10634 investigate the role of non-ideal magnetohydrodynamics and the influence of magnetic fields on the thermal structure of accretion disks, contributing evidence relevant to the question of how vertical magnetic fields influence accretion processes.
